enquire_deliveries_by_scenario.name: Enquire Deliveries By Scenario
enquire_deliveries_by_scenario.description: Debugging assistant to show list of deliveries for each scenario, including default usage

data_description.template_path: Optional location where Jinja2 templates for HTML email are to be found
data_description.media_path: Storage path for media created during notifications, for example camera snapshots created for attachments
data_description.media_url_prefix: URL path prefix under which stored media, such as camera snapshots, is served
data_description.mobile_discovery: Automatically discover mobile app devices registered in Home Assistant for push notifications
data_description.recipients_discovery: Automatically discover recipients from Home Assistant person entities
data_description.archive_path: Storage path for archived notifications, useful for debugging configuration, scenarios etc

data_description.file_retention_days: How many days of archived notifications to keep
data_description.mqtt_topic: Optional MQTT topic to publish archived notifications to
data_description.mqtt_qos: MQTT quality of service level used when publishing archived notifications
data_description.mqtt_retain: Whether archived notifications published to MQTT are retained
data_description.purge_interval: Minimum interval in minutes between automatic archive purges
data_description.event_name: Home Assistant event name fired for archived notifications
data_description.event_selection: Which notification outcomes fire an event, as pipe-separated names, for example ERROR|DUPE
data_description.diagnostics: Which notification outcomes are recorded with full diagnostic detail, as pipe-separated names

data_description.ttl: How long a notification is remembered for duplicate detection
data_description.size: Maximum number of recent notifications remembered for duplicate detection
data_description.dupe_policy: How strictly notifications are compared to detect duplicates

data_description.housekeeping_time: Time of day (HH:MM:SS) that scheduled housekeeping, such as media purge, runs
data_description.media_storage_days: How many days of stored media, such as snapshots and attachments, to keep
